events.title: VINS Annual Online Auction
events.description:
VINS Annual Online Auction
October 14 – November 6*

Browse Auction Items

The VINS Annual Auction will raise funds to support our work across the entire organization: our environmental education programs, research, and wildlife rehabilitation efforts. Your participation in the auction helps us reach thousands of children, educators, adult learners and bird patients each year. Whether you’re looking for something special for yourself or a loved one, this is a wonderful way to support VINS and local businesses this holiday season.

Support with a bid and get a little something in return!

*Opens to VINS Members on October 12 at 12 PM.

Thank you for your support!

events.title: Coffee in the Canopy
events.description:
Coffee in the Canopy
Thursday, October 15
8:30 AM – 10 AM
FREE and open to the public*

Due to inclement weather expected on Friday, we are moving this event up a day to Thursday, October 15th.

Register Today

Greet the day high among the treetops on the Forest Canopy Walk at this free, adults-only cultivation series. Before our opening hours, sip coffee and savor fresh pastries as the morning sun lights up the Ottauquechee River and the forest foliage. Enjoy conversation with our Executive Director Alden Smith and VINS Staff in a peaceful forest setting.

Refreshments provided by The Woodland Fairy.

Generously sponsored by Kate & Co.

*Registration is required. Please note this is an adults-only event.

For more information contact us at [contact omitted] or [contact omitted].

events.title: Forest Storytime
events.description:
Forest Storytime
Thursdays, October 15 & 22
10:30 AM – 11:00 AM

Join an Educator for our early learner’s storytime sessions. We’ll read stories, play games, sing songs, and laugh with puppets. Each session will focus on a different topic to learn about animals, plants, or other wonders of nature. This experience is designed to help promote connection, exploration, curiosity, and joy for the outdoors.

This program is for children 5 and younger. Please arrive 15 minutes early to allow time to purchase admission tickets at the Nature Store – you’ll be directed to the location on campus.

For more information, contact us at [contact omitted] or [contact omitted].

events.title: Natural Wonders
events.description:
Natural Wonders
10:30 AM – 10:50 AM

Join us on a journey of discovery through the wonders of the natural world. Designed for families with young children, this short interactive program explores a range of engaging topics including animals of New England, Animal Engineers, and local habitats.*

Location changes daily – inquire at the Nature Store.

*Includes a live animal on Saturdays and Sundays only.

events.title: Predators of the Sky
events.description:
Predators of the Sky
11 AM – 11:30 AM

Take flight with us for an unforgettable experience! We’ll show you the unique nature of some of the world’s most highly skilled predators – raptors! In this live bird demonstration you’ll gain an up-close view and an in-depth understanding of these majestic birds. What makes a bird a raptor? How sharp are those talons? What does an owl’s wing sound like as it moves through the air? Join a VINS Educator and explore these adaptations and meet some of these birds up close.

For more information, contact us at [contact omitted] or [contact omitted].

events.title: Woodland Wildlife Walk
events.description:
Woodland Wildlife Walk
1 PM – 1:30 PM

Come wander through the woods with us! Not only is VINS home to dozens of exhibit birds, but our 2.5 miles of trails are teeming with a variety of wildlife. Learn to identify the plants that support our diverse fauna, keep your eyes out for signs of animal activity, and, if we’re lucky, perhaps we’ll spot some critters, too!

Meet at the trailhead by the Forest Canopy Walk.

For more information, contact us at [contact omitted] or [contact omitted].

events.title: Saw-whet Owl Banding Demonstration
events.description:
Saw-whet Owl Banding Demonstration

8:00 PM – 9:30 PM
FREE and Open to the Public*

Please sign up for one date only:
Thursday, October 15 – Event Full! Join the Waitlist Today
Wednesday, October 21 – Event Full! Join the Waitlist Today

Smaller than a softball, Northern Saw-whet Owls are some of Vermont’s most elusive residents. In the fall, many of these tiny owls undertake long journeys to wintering grounds farther south. In 2024, VINS established a Saw-whet Owl banding station to trap and monitor these migrants as they pass through the forests at our Nature Center.

The VINS Field Research Team invites you to join them for a shift to learn about the banding process and how their work, and that of researchers at hundreds of banding stations around the country, is shedding light on the lives of these secretive birds.

If we get birds in hand, our team will demonstrate how these birds are carefully weighed, measured, and banded before release back to the wild. Please note, while the chances are good, we cannot guarantee that we will successfully capture any owls during this event.

This program is designed for adults. Interested youth 8 and up may participate with an adult.

For the health and safety of the birds, the banding station is not open in rainy weather. In the event that weather forces us to cancel, VINS will contact you the day of the event.

Make a Donation
*Please consider donating to the Center for Field Research to support our work.

Registration is required as space is limited.

For more information, contact us at [contact omitted] or [contact omitted].

events.title: Raptors in Focus: Photography Workshop
events.description:
Raptors in Focus: Photography Workshop
Sunday, October 25
1 PM – 3 PM

$56 General Public / $51 VINS Members

Register Today

Join local photojournalist Rob Strong for an exclusive photo shoot with our resident raptors that will leave you with stunning pictures and great memories. With a focus on capturing movement, our raptor models will be flying for the camera, allowing you to get amazing action shots.

Designed for the intermediate level photographer, Rob will go over essential techniques help you get the most out of your camera, maximizing results and improving wildlife photography skills.

Program Activities:
Rob will offer a slideshow on camera settings and photography techniques, followed by flight and portrait session with several different raptors, setting and backdrop weather dependent.

Details for Participants:
Spend a full day at the VINS Nature Center. Purchase discounted admission to the VINS Nature Center for $5. Discount available only to registered participants on the day of the workshop.

Participants should bring a camera and plenty of storage (be it digital or film).

This workshop is designed for adults 18 and up. Interested youth 13 and up may participate with an adult. No registration fee required for an adult accompanying a youth participant unless the adult also plans to participate in the workshop.

Instructor Bio:
www.robstrong.com

Registration is required. For more information, contact us at [contact omitted] or [contact omitted].
